QuestInfo.name: Respite
QuestInfo.0: The Sand Bandits had planned their raid on the day Phantom was planning his grand theft of the Goddess Teardrop. Alpha and Beta could do nothing but wait. Luckily, they overheard #b#p2420018##k talking an event in #m322000000#.
QuestInfo.1:
The duo entered the popular scorpion-catching contest in #m322000000#. To win, they would have to #bcatch the scorpions with a rope#k. It would take a total of #b10#k to win the competition.

#r(Tip: You must forfeit and restart the quest if you leave the competition area without catching all the scorpions.)
QuestInfo.2: According to a local named #p2420018#, the scorpion catching contest in #m322000000# was proposed by the Shah to deal with the aggressive scorpion population. Alpha and Beta had done some good!

1.0: Wow, you caught a lot of scorpions! Let me see... One... Two... Ten! The Prime Minister's going to be very impressed. I can't wait to see the twinkle in his piercing eyes!

yes.0: The king and queen didn't do a thing about all the scorpions, but our wonderful Shah Mar sure did. It takes a smart man to turn a big problem into a community event.
yes.1: Ariant would've been in shambles if it wasn't for #bShah Mar#k. Makes an old timer like me feel good to see a pretty young fella doing right by his people. Don't be fooled by that adorable boy-face, though. #bHe's a lot older than he looks#k!
